hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"You are on the $branch branch. Create a feature branch first: git checkout -b feat/your-feature-name\"}"; fi; fi
